title: Do not interchange a damaging event with an entire production cycle
statement: At .003 independent critical-stock loss per damaging event, 600 events leave .164852 functional stock. Retaining 95% after 600 events without replenishment permits at most 8.54852e-5 loss per event. This differs from .003 loss per whole production cycle. Independent twenty-step hidden errors share the .00525417 per-step budget among retention, chemistry, transfer, cleavage, reset and release; correlations require their own treatment.

Existing full-library, chemistry, assay, function, renewal and cost gaps remain open.
